introduction.heading: About
zh: 3 年+产品、工业与包装设计经验，聚焦美妆个护包装、品牌产品设计与结构落地。
WWP Beauty 期间参与 30+ 项目，并在 15+ 项目中承担项目管理职责，具备从需求拆解、概念与 CMF、结构协同、打样测试到量产交付的完整经验；在 HEAVEN PINK 形成品牌产品语言、系列视觉统筹及产品—包装—上市视觉协同能力，并持续探索 AI 在概念生成、方案表达与设计提效中的应用。
en: 3+ years of experience across product, industrial and packaging design, with a focus on beauty and personal-care packaging, branded product design and production-ready development.

At WWP Beauty, I contributed to 30+ projects and took on project-management responsibilities in 15+, building end-to-end experience from brief definition, concept and CMF through structural collaboration, prototyping, testing and mass-production delivery. At HEAVEN PINK, I developed brand product language, coordinated series-level visual systems and connected product, packaging and launch visuals, while continuing to explore AI for concept generation, design communication and workflow efficiency.

experienceIntro: Working from the brand side across beauty product design, packaging and visual systems, with a focus on building a more consistent product language from concept through launch.

experience.en: Working from the brand side across beauty product design, packaging and visual systems, with a focus on building a more consistent product language from concept through launch.
experience.zh: 从品牌侧参与美妆产品、包装及视觉体系设计，重点建立更统一的产品语言，并推动设计从概念开发延伸至上市呈现。

experience.en: Developed beauty packaging for global and Chinese brands across concept design, CMF, structural development, prototyping and production, contributing to 30+ projects from early exploration to manufacturing.
experience.zh: 参与国内外美妆品牌包装开发，覆盖概念设计、CMF、结构开发、打样与量产，在 30+ 项目中积累从前期探索到制造落地的完整经验。

experience.en: Designed album packaging and visual systems across print, physical media and promotional applications, building an early foundation in graphic systems, materials and production.
experience.zh: 负责唱片包装及视觉系统设计，覆盖印刷、实体媒介与宣传延展，由此建立对平面系统、材料与生产工艺的早期理解。

brands.noteEn: Selected brands and projects contributed to during my work at WWP Beauty.
brands.noteZh: 部分品牌及项目来自 WWP Beauty 任职期间参与的设计与开发工作。

capabilities.en: From product form and packaging architecture to applicators and interaction details, I develop beauty products around both brand identity and everyday use.
capabilities.zh: 从产品造型、包装结构到涂抹器与交互细节，以品牌识别与真实使用体验为出发点构建设计方案。

capabilities.en: I build coherent product families through colour, material, finish and detail, translating brand identity into a physical design language.
capabilities.zh: 通过色彩、材料、表面处理与细节规则建立统一的产品家族，将品牌语言转化为可感知的实体产品语言。

capabilities.en: I work closely with engineers and suppliers to move concepts beyond visuals, balancing design intent with structure, tooling, cost and manufacturing constraints.
capabilities.zh: 与结构工程师及供应商协同推进设计，在设计意图、结构、模具、成本与制造限制之间寻找可执行的平衡。

capabilities.en: From prototypes and colour samples to production-ready details, I follow designs through iteration and validation to help ensure the final product retains its original intent.
capabilities.zh: 从模型、颜色样到量产细节，通过多轮打样、验证与调整持续推进方案，使最终产品尽可能保留最初的设计意图。

process.keywordsZh: 品牌 / 用户 / 市场
概念 / 造型 / 交互
结构 / 工程 / 开模
模型 / 打样 / 测试

processStatementEn: Design doesn't stop when the rendering is finished.
processStatementZh: 对我而言，设计并不会在效果图完成时结束。

bring.en: Experience across beauty products, packaging, applicators and production gives me a practical understanding of how the category works beyond appearance.
bring.zh: 长期围绕美妆产品、包装、涂抹器及生产开发工作，让我对这一品类的理解不仅停留在外观层面。

bring.en: I move comfortably between visual ideas and technical constraints, helping concepts survive the transition from presentation to production.
bring.zh: 能够在视觉设计与工程限制之间切换，让概念不仅在提案中成立，也能够经受从设计到生产的转换。

bring.en: Experience on both supplier and brand sides helps me understand the different priorities behind design, engineering, sourcing and launch.
bring.zh: 品牌方与供应商两侧的工作经历，让我能够理解设计、工程、采购与上市过程中不同角色的判断逻辑。

bring.en: I pay attention to the small decisions — a radius, a click, a surface transition or a colour shift — because these details often define how a product ultimately feels.
bring.zh: 我关注那些看似微小的决定：一个圆角、一次开合、一处分面或一点色差，因为最终决定产品质感的，往往正是这些细节。

values.en: Remove what doesn't need to be there.
values.zh: 去掉不必要的设计，让产品表达更加直接。

values.en: Let proportion, material and detail speak before decoration.
values.zh: 让比例、材料与细节先于装饰表达。

values.en: A good idea becomes meaningful when it survives reality.
values.zh: 好的想法，需要经得住现实世界的制造与使用。

recognition.title: iF New Talent Award 2020
recognition.en: Sustainable design concept exploring agricultural material reuse.
recognition.zh: 以农业材料再利用为核心的可持续设计方案。

cta.titleZh: 让想法成为真实的产品。
bodyEn: I'm interested in beauty products, packaging systems and the small interactions that make everyday objects feel considered.
Currently open to product and packaging design opportunities in China and internationally.
bodyZh: 持续关注美妆产品、包装系统，以及那些让日常物件变得更值得使用的微小交互。
目前开放中国及海外的美妆产品与包装设计机会。
